search_scope: Targeted novelty stress-test of attempt aggregation, paired future-target evidence, and mastery-decision reliability. No priority claim; five closest additional sources only.

evidence.section: Repository Description and Steps to reproduce
evidence.finding: Matched BKT conditions share parameters, pre-episode state and next same-skill outcome; metadata reports AUC but not Brier/RMSE gains.

caveats: Metadata alone establishes an earlier public description, not a validated replication or peer-reviewed result.

Author names follow DataCite creator parsing (given Nguyen, family Hoa; given Van Khoa, family Le).

sources.title: Correctness Is Not Homogeneous Evidence: A Correctness-conditioned Evidence-aware Knowledge Tracing Model
sources.status: arXiv version 1 preprint; peer-reviewed venue unverified

evidence.finding: Separates future windows for weak supervision and proxy validity.
Student/seed uncertainty, context-permutation and random-proxy controls, behavior-fusion ablations and proper scores.
Acknowledges unstable independent proxy benefit and noncausal interpretation.

caveats: No repository linked in the inspected PDF; no code reproduction.
Behavioral gating and proxy-validity diagnostics are established overlap; exact paired same-future-item replay is not the central reported estimand.

sources.title: Augmenting Knowledge Tracing With Self-Regulated Learning Indicators for Reliable Skill-Mastery Estimation
sources.status: L@S 2026 published proceedings article; bibliographic metadata and institutional abstract verified

evidence.finding: Studies mastery-threshold crossings with weak regulation, including repeated attempts, and subsequent struggle in ASSISTments.

caveats: HKU explicitly lists no associated files; full ACM article inaccessible in this audit.
Exact thresholds, estimation procedure and within-paper page/section anchors are unknown; do not infer them from abstract.

sources.title: Self-attention in Knowledge Tracing: Why It Works

evidence.finding: Student CV and all-versus-first-attempt comparisons include CSEDM programming data.
DPFA+ compresses repeated attempts into batches and models within-batch success/failure counts.

access.full_text_mode: Web-indexed 9-page manuscript uploaded by Shi Pu on ResearchGate

caveats: ResearchGate heading is incorrectly the whole proceedings; manuscript text and publisher chapter metadata identify the actual paper.
Page anchors refer to the 9-page author manuscript, not the six published pages.
Publisher PDF fetch returned non-PDF; linked ResearchGate download returned 404. No PDF hash is available.

sources.title: Knowledge Tracing for Complex Problem Solving: Granular Rank-Based Tensor Factorization

evidence.finding: Adaptive attempt aggregation in knowledge tracing.
Next-attempt student-CV evaluation, aggregation ablations and knowledge-state fluctuation diagnostics, including programming datasets.

caveats: Page anchors refer to the 16-page author manuscript, not ten proceedings pages.
Repository URL is cited by the paper; code was not inspected or reproduced in this pass.
The 2022 arXiv deposit is not the 2021 publication date.
